text.tspan: Experience of Christ — Fellowship with Him
Tell Him in sorrow, in your depression.
Speak to Him from the heart.
All the tears as they flow,
He then collects in His bottle,
Tell Him your sins and preoccupations;
Not a thing you can’t say.
Speak when in darkness, troubled and anxious,
As we vent and we cry,
He draws near to our side.
Tell Him your joys and all your elations.
He makes all pure in Him,
I’ve handed over my ev’ry burden
Now He owns and He’ll share.
I’ll tell Him and tell Him
